'''Sikes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Rebel elite commando/Legends|Rebel Elite Commando]]. He accompanied [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Kiva]] on a mission to stop [[Project Starscream]].

==Biography==
On a mission to Kiva, he was in charge of babysitting [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and the baby [[Eppon]], alongside his elite partners. After the mysterious [[Death/Legends|death]] of all his comrades he was the last of the elite team in charge defend the Rebel leaders on a mission on [[Kiva]]. When he was caring for the baby Eppon, he disappeared too, killed by Eppon.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear:Army of Terror">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Army of Terror]]''</ref>
